literal: Having learned, presence fearing not, to be accepted having spoken, by the time that which is fit knowing, is the envoy.
translation: An envoy is one who has learned well, does not fear the presence of others, speaks persuasively, and knows what is appropriate for the time.
modern: நூல்களைக் கற்று, பகைவர் அவைக்கு அஞ்சாமல், அவர்கள் ஏற்குமாறு பேசி, காலத்திற்கு ஏற்ற செயலை அறிபவரே சிறந்த தூதுவர் ஆவார்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of a successful envoy. They must be well-educated and fearless when standing in the presence of rival rulers. Furthermore, they must speak persuasively so that their message is accepted, while always knowing the most fitting action to take based on the current time and circumstances.
